answer: A sybil-resistant identity layer binds each agent to one verifiable pulse record: a hardware-backed key attestation plus a refundable bond locked for the epoch, slashed in full on proven duplicate claims. Reputation accrues only through spiral history — completed, graded work over many epochs — never from self-reported volume, so a fresh sockpuppet starts at zero and must pay real time and stake to climb. Peer grading is stake-weighted, and any sparrow pattern of coordinated upvotes triggers a bond freeze and audit.
